Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a model plan for private residential fire sprinkler water charges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to private residential fire sprinkler watercharges; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state building code council shalldevelop a model pricing plan for private residential fire sprinklerwater charges by December 1, 2007. The council must survey otherstates during the development process and make the supporting dataavailable to local jurisdictions upon request.
